name: Pitcher
overview: The Scripture presents the pitcher as an earthen vessel, notably used by Gideon during his battle against the Midianites. In the narrative, Gideon's faith is strengthened as he observes the overwhelming enemy forces and receives confirmation through a dream about God's deliverance. This context highlights the pitcher not just as a practical object but as part of God's sovereign plan to empower His people to triumph against great odds.
